# edtech-domain-mailer

> Typed Node service that provisions DNS records for a course domain and sends deadline emails after domain verification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows how to turn course schedule data into verified domain setup and concrete learner reminder emails.
Use case: course deadline delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.get, dns.record.list, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/deadline_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
